# Choose a Dutch oven

## Context

Loaves bake best in a covered pot that traps steam.

## Decision

A cast-iron combo cooker, because the shallow half makes loading the dough easy.

## Alternatives considered

An enamelled Dutch oven: deeper, harder to load, and the enamel can craze at high heat.

## Consequences

The cooker is heavy; it lives on the bottom shelf of the oven.
